import re

async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to fully load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Look for elements in the main content that contain numeric text (commit counts)
    # Use a regex pattern to match one or more digits
    regex_pattern = re.compile(r'\d+')
    commit_count_element = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_text(regex_pattern).first
    if await commit_count_element.count() > 0:
        await commit_count_element.wait_for(state='visible')
        commit_count_text = await commit_count_element.text_content()
        return commit_count_text.strip()
    else:
        # If no numeric text is found, return an empty string
        return ''
